Measurement Guide

Measure your head, step by step.

Use a flexible measuring tape, keep hair flat, and record every measurement in inches. These measurements are used for custom-cap sizing.

1

Circumference

Wrap the tape around the entire hairline — across the forehead, behind both ears, and around the nape.

2

Front to Nape

From the center front hairline, over the highest point of the crown, down to the lowest point of the nape.

3

Ear to Ear Across Forehead

Measure across the front hairline, from where each ear meets the head.

4

Ear to Ear Over Top

From ear to ear, up and over the highest point of the crown.

5

Temple to Temple Around Back

Measure around the back of the head, from one temple to the other, passing below the crown.

6

Nape Width

Measure straight across the natural hairline at the base of the nape.

Quick Tips

Measure over one thin cap or with hair braided flat — never over loose, bulky hair.

Have a second person help for the most accurate result.

Record every number in inches, to the nearest quarter inch.
